review_scope: One same-request controller-owner takeover after the first CodeBuild is terminal, retaining the existing scientific worker, request, deadline, state, checkpoint lineage, and single scientific submission.

source_findings.takeover_entry: cloud::begin loads the existing ConfigMap and exact request-bound State before considering a new state
source_findings.terminal_owner_gate: State::claim changes owner_build only when batch-get-builds reports the prior owner in an accepted terminal status
source_findings.cas_boundary: Stored::save uses Kubernetes replace with the existing resourceVersion
source_findings.request_binding: State::bind_request requires the durable request hash and parsed request to equal the supplied immutable request
source_findings.worker_attempt_semantics: State.attempt equals State.restores and increments only in begin_restore; controller-owner takeover does not increment either field
source_findings.running_worker_semantics: A takeover in running, checkpointing, or verifying_computation reconciles the existing Pod and supervisor instead of provisioning a replacement attempt
source_findings.terminal_state_semantics: An already terminal durable State is published and returned without restarting scientific work
source_findings.missing_state_semantics: A deleted or missing durable ConfigMap is not acceptable for this takeover; the permanent request tombstone prevents treating the run as a new computation

controller_attempt_accounting.note: The source does not persist a controller-build attempt counter; the maximum of two is enforced by the external receipt and authorization boundary. State.attempt is the worker restore count, not the CodeBuild controller count.

takeover_start_build.reason_not_to_use_submit: A second submit emits another scientific submission receipt and reuses the original request idempotency token. The takeover is an infrastructure controller-owner transition under the original submission.

per_build_timeout_review.actual_start_requirement: Recompute NEED and MAX immediately before StartBuild using the actual current UTC time; reject if max(5, NEED) exceeds MAX.
per_build_timeout_review.scope_conclusion: The per-build timeout and queue overrides affect only this CodeBuild invocation. They do not update the project, IAM, RBAC, package, controller source, request, worker, G, D, scientific budget, or restore limit.

required_takeover_receipt_fields: raw request digest and controller request identity
original build id and exact terminal status observation
new build id and takeover idempotency token
controller source version and source archive digest
approved client, runtime image, scientific image, source revision and ecbench digests
pre-takeover phase, attempt, restores, current instance and current Pod UID
timeoutInMinutesOverride, queuedTimeoutInMinutesOverride, actual calculation time, NEED, MAX, G, D and reserve
stop_conditions: prior CodeBuild is not conclusively terminal
durable request, run name or owner differs
durable attempt or restores is nonzero
durable phase is fencing or restoring
worker instance is not running or its identity differs
durable State or its ConfigMap is missing
another controller takeover already consumed infrastructure attempt 2
recomputed timeout no longer fits inside the outer window with the queue allowance
limitations: The takeover changes the controller owner only; it does not prove that the existing worker will never fail later.
A later worker failure can enter the request's already admitted fencing and one-restore path. If no later restore is acceptable, the operator must stop instead of permitting that transition.
The CodeBuild timeout is not a scientific runtime estimate and does not extend the worker past G.
The projected NEED and MAX values must not substitute for the mandatory calculation at the actual StartBuild time.
No third controller attempt is authorized if the takeover build later terminates before durable completion.
